dedupe_keys.name: bipad nepal s national disaster information management system with an open api for incidents losses critical resources relief and hydromet data

description: BIPAD is the Government of Nepal's disaster information management system, which brings incidents, losses, critical resources and monitoring data for the whole country into one map portal. Behind the portal is a public REST API whose root lists well over a hundred endpoints. These include verified disaster incidents with locations and ward identifiers, losses to people, families, infrastructure, agriculture and livestock, and resources such as health facilities, schools and open spaces for evacuation. Others cover relief stock and distributions, river, rainfall and air pollution stations, fire and earthquake feeds, situation reports, COVID-19 series, and administrative units down to ward level. When read, the incident and resource endpoints returned records without a key, for example a verified 2023 fire incident and a sub health post with coordinates. The portal and API are free to use, and data are available to download as JSON through paginated queries. Caveats: no licence is stated, the portal renders by script, record counts are not reported by the API, and completeness depends on local reporting. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: historical incident and loss data for hazard impact models, and facility and open-space locations for emergency response planning. Related records: the Nepal Annual Health Report (data-nepal-dohs-annual-health-report) complements the health facility layer.
